id: title:Gilbert09:keep the wizard step when reconnecting an account

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse integration recovery and wizard context preservation
review.reason: Adds parameters `reconnectReturnUrl` and `INTEGRATION_ERROR_PARAM` to preserve warehouse wizard context during account reconnection, supporting recovery without losing warehouse selection.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual recovery behavior or adoption. Tier 2 assigned because implementation and relevant checks are visible, but unverified outcomes and lack of broader systemic context prevent Tier 3.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned as requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter `reconnectReturnUrl` to the import and its corresponding implementation, and uses it to preserve the warehouse wizard context when re-authorizing an integration.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse account reconnection to retain the warehouse wizard context rather than returning to the warehouse catalog, supporting recovery without losing the user's warehouse selection.
